text:
Maya: Quick thread to align on CloudCo private-offer launch across AWS/GCP/Azure. Scope: onboarding checklist, legal copy for telemetry, and regional image packaging.

Diego: I'll own the marketplace wiring (offer creation + SKU mapping). Need the final product slug and desired SKUs for paid vs trial.

Harper: I'll handle images and CI -> publish pipeline. Reminder: GCP uses different image format and export flow than AWS AMIs. We'll need separate build jobs and manifests.

Neha: Legal here. Telemetry must be opt-out on marketplace listings where required. Send me concrete events and whether any logs include customer identifiers (user_id, account_id).

Maya: Product: paid_sku: cloudco-pro, trial_sku: cloudco-trial. Trials should auto-expire at 14 days. Diego, map these to private SKUs so we can control redemption.

Diego: Copy. I'll set up mapping. Question for infra: do we want single publisher bucket per cloud or per-region buckets for geo residency?

Harper: Per-region buckets is safer for latency and compliance. We'll output a manifest JSON that lists region->image-id. Sample manifest: ```json
{
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "ami": "ami-0a1b2c3d4e",
  "kms_key": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/abcd"
}
```

Neha: From a privacy POV, if we keep logs in-region and allow customers to supply their own KMS keys, mention that in listing. Also draft marketplace line: "Customers may provide a customer-managed key (CMK) for image encryption; admin consent required."

legal-bot: legal-check: Telemetry clause template attached. Requires product confirmation on event list. Link: https://legal.internal/docs/telemetry-templates

Maya: Engineering: confirm that telemetry payload will include sku, region, and trial_status boolean. We need that for legal and billing reconciliation.

Harper: Will include sku and trial_expiry timestamp as part of the anonymous event metadata. No customer PII emitted.

Diego: Marketplace private offer flow note: for Azure, we need offer metering configuration and publisher tenant ID. Also need connector credentials to ingest listing assets. I'll request those from CloudCo.

Maya: Can someone draft the publisher portal checklist so we can hand to CloudCo? Items: IdP metadata, publishing IAM role (minimal), CMK ARN (optional), manifest per-region, contact for billing email, and co-marketing assets.

Neha: I'll draft EULA telemetry snippet: "By enabling this offer, you agree to anonymous telemetry for service quality and security. No PII will be exported to third parties without explicit consent. Customers may opt to supply CMKs to restrict key exportability."

Harper: CI tickets: BUILD-771 (aws images), BUILD-772 (gcp images), BUILD-773 (azure images). I'll link build artifacts to the manifest and output S3/GS/AZ blob paths.

pub-bot: publisher-portal: CloudCo: account created, dev role pending. Upload webhook: https://publisher.redwood.ai/hooks/xyz789

Diego: I'll compile the checklist doc and share a Google drive folder with onboarding artifacts by EOD.

Maya: Solid. Next sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. If anyone hits blockers, post here. :rocket:
